name: [Portal] Export existing medailonky from partner WordPress sites CZ/SK/HU (migration)
description:
### Summary

This task is the first half of migrating existing partner profiles (medailonky) into CRM. All current profiles live in three WordPress partner websites for the Czech, Slovak and Hungarian markets, outside the Shoptet monorepo. Before the Partner Portal opens, that content must be brought into the new CRM tables so partners see their profile pre-filled and the websites keep their content at cutover. The task delivers a repeatable, read-only export: an inventory of the WordPress fields, taxonomies and media on each site, a mapping table from WordPress fields to CRM columns with keep or drop decisions, a command that produces one normalized record per partner per language plus logo files, conversion of the HTML body into the restricted Markdown subset with a report of anything dropped, and a data-quality report of missing e-mails, duplicates across sites and broken links. Nothing is written to CRM here; matching and import are the follow-up task.

### Why?

All current partner medailonky live in three WordPress partner websites (CZ, SK, HU) outside the monorepo. The MVP makes CRM the master record, so every existing medailonek has to move into `st_crm.partner` / `partner_lng` before the portal opens; otherwise partners start from an empty profile and the websites lose content on cutover. Export is the read-only first half of the migration; import and matching are a separate task.

### What?

A repeatable export of all published medailonky from the three WordPress sites into one normalized dataset (one record per partner per language) with a field inventory mapped onto the CRM schema. Includes the inventory of WordPress fields, taxonomies and media per site, a mapping table WordPress → CRM (fields with no target, CRM fields with no source), conversion of the HTML body to the restricted Markdown subset with a report of dropped constructs, logo download, and a data-quality report. No write to CRM in this task.

### Acceptance Criteria

Field inventory per site (CZ/SK/HU): custom fields, taxonomies (categories, regions), media, publish status

Re-runnable export command produces the normalized dataset (one record per partner per language) plus logos for all three sites without manual steps

HTML → Markdown conversion uses the subset from 

; per-record report of dropped or changed constructs

Data-quality report with counts per site: missing contact e-mail, likely duplicates across sites (same name, url or IČO), broken logo or url, empty description

Export is read-only against WordPress; the run is documented so it can be repeated right before cutover

Sample of 10 records per site reviewed with Partnership for correctness

### Open questions

- Wiki Q4 (DevRel): which value wins when WordPress and CRM/project data differ (public vs. billing e-mail)? Decided in the import task; the export preserves both.
- Access: read the sites via WordPress REST API, DB dump or WP export? Who runs the hosting (microsites vendor)?
- Do unpublished or draft medailonky in WordPress migrate too?

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-09-16_

- The WordPress sites have no code or config in the monorepo; only marketing links (`cms/controllers/ShoptetFooterController.php`, storefront templates) and allow-lists (`cms/packages/Cors/Helper/CorsHeaders.php`, `cms/packages/Statistics/Helper/InternalStatsHelper.php`).
- Target schema: `database/schema/st_crm.sql` → `partner` (L2438), `partner_lng` (L2533), `partner_category_lng` (L2488, slug unique per language).
- `partner.slug` is globally unique; the same partner may exist on three sites under different slugs, so the mapping must pick one and keep the others for redirects.
- Build the export as a Symfony Console command in the PartnerPortal package (repeatable, testable), not a one-off script.
